title: Bounded flat complex on the small etale site
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring in universe $u+1$, $X$ a scheme in universe $u$, and $P$ a cochain complex of sheaves of $R$-modules on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ in the ordinary derived-module setting [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. For arbitrary integers $a,b$, say that $P$ is a bounded flat complex in $[a,b]$ if $P^q$ is a zero object whenever $q<a$ or $b<q$, and every $P^q$ is flat, meaning that tensoring with it is exact [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. No assumption $a\le b$ is imposed; when $a>b$ all terms must be zero.
